<module id="barrel_shifter">
    <description>A barrel shifter for rotating bits efficiently. This 8-bit barrel shifter takes an 8-bit input and shifts or rotates the bits based on a 3-bit control signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input to be shifted.</input>
        <input id="ctrl" width_description="[2:0]">3-bit control signal that determines how many positions to shift. The control signal specifies the amount of shift, where each bit indicates a shift by 1, 2, or 4 positions.</input>
        <output id="out" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit shifted output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_STAGES" value="3">Number of stages in the barrel shifter.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <variable id="stage_out" width_description="[7:0][NUM_STAGES-1:0]">Array of wires representing outputs of each stage.</variable>
        <variable id="i" width_description="[3:0]">Loop index variable.</variable>
        
        // Assign initial stage output
        assign stage_out[0] = in;
        // Generate loop to iterate through stages
        generate
            genvar j;
            for (j = 0; j < NUM_STAGES; j = j + 1) begin : mux_loop
                // Create mux2X1 instance
                mux2X1 mux (
                    .in(in),
                    .sel(ctrl[j]),
                    .out(stage_out[j+1])
                );
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Assign final stage output to output port
        assign out = stage_out[NUM_STAGES];
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // The barrel shifter shifts the input 'in' based on the value of the 'ctrl' signal.
        // The shifting happens in stages, where each stage shifts by 4, 2, or 1 position,
        // as controlled by 'ctrl[2]', 'ctrl[1]', and 'ctrl[0]' respectively.
        // The shifts are achieved using a series of 2-to-1 multiplexers ('mux2X1') that select between the shifted input and the original input.
        // Each stage of multiplexers performs the shift, and the result is passed to the next stage for further shifting if required.
        // When 'ctrl[2]' is high, the input is shifted by 4 positions.
        // When 'ctrl[1]' is high, the intermediate result is shifted by 2 positions.
        // When 'ctrl[0]' is high, the intermediate result is shifted by 1 position.
        // The 'mux2X1' submodule is used to select between two input values based on the 'sel' signal,
        // determining which bit is used in the shifted output at each stage.
    </implementation>
    <task>
        <id>rotate_left</id>
        <description>Rotates the input left by the specified number of positions.</description>
        <parameters>
            <parameter id="input" width_description="[7:0]">The input to be rotated.</parameter>
            <parameter id="positions" width_description="[2:0]">The number of positions to rotate the input.</parameter>
        </parameters>
        <returns>The rotated input.</returns>
        <implementation>
            // Implementation of the rotate_left task goes here.
        </implementation>
    </task>
</module>
